authority: CEO R323 §P3 — simulator registry with evidence classes

cardiovascular_CFD.why: Open-source parallel FEM solver for incompressible Navier-Stokes, FSI, RCR boundary conditions. Official test suite with reference cases. Extracted and executed in this environment (R317-R322).
cardiovascular_CFD.unavailable: NO — successfully installed via Docker layer extraction + micromamba MPI
cardiovascular_CFD.fallback: 1D scipy ODE (INSUFFICIENT for comparative experiments — P-19 falsification showed 1D can reverse conclusion)
cardiovascular_CFD.evidence_class: INDEPENDENT_COMPUTATIONALLY_VALIDATED when executed on candidate geometry

tissue_optics.why: PyTissueOptics: 3D Monte Carlo, pip-installable, CPU mode. MCX: GPU Monte Carlo gold standard.
tissue_optics.unavailable: PARTIAL — PyTissueOptics available (R311+). MCX blocked (no CUDA GPU).
tissue_optics.fallback: Analytical approximations (diffusion, Kubelka-Munk) — INSUFFICIENT (R310 showed 60-70% disagreement)
tissue_optics.evidence_class: INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED (PyTissueOptics is genuinely independent). MCX would strengthen to MECHANISM_EXTERNALLY_VERIFIED.

biomechanics_FEA.why: Open-source biomechanics FEA with 140+ verification problems. Soft tissue, porous media, contact mechanics.
biomechanics_FEA.unavailable: YES — cannot install (no Docker image found, no pip, no build toolchain for C++/MPI/PETSc)
biomechanics_FEA.fallback: scipy ODE for simplified mechanics (INSUFFICIENT for full FEA verification)

biochemical_kinetics.why: Open-source ODE/SDE/Gillespie biochemical simulator with parameter estimation.
biochemical_kinetics.unavailable: YES — not installed (would need pip or binary). COPASI 4.46 available for download.
biochemical_kinetics.fallback: scipy.solve_ivp with LSODA (mathematically equivalent for ODE systems, but not the established external engine)
biochemical_kinetics.evidence_class: EXTERNAL_SOLVER_UNAVAILABLE (scipy fallback used for P-05, documented as deviation)

statistical_ML.why: Established ML library with cross-validation, reproducible seeds.
statistical_ML.evidence_class: INDEPENDENTLY_COMPUTATIONALLY_VALIDATED when cross-validated with frozen seed

energy_harvesting.why: No dedicated external simulator for cardiac energy harvesting. Published in-vivo measurements are the strongest external evidence.

selection_rule: The machine selects the simulator from the physical mechanism. It does NOT select because it produces a favorable result. When the best external solver is unavailable, the machine states EXTERNAL_SOLVER_UNAVAILABLE and uses the documented fallback with explicit evidence class degradation.
